mapper.insert: insert into b_browsing_history (uid, target_id, target_title, target_uid, target_type, create_time, update_time) values (#{add.uid}, #{add.targetId}, #{add.targetTitle}, #{add.targetUid}, #{add.targetType}, #{add.createTime}, #{add.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE update_time = VALUES (update_time);
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateTimes, COUNT(*) as censusSum FROM b_browsing_history WHERE target_uid = #{targetUid} and target_type = 1 and update_time >= #{time} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
